about: The music bed and the sound effects, and where they sit. Read by render.mjs and tools/mix.mjs: music {file, gain_db, in, fade_in, fade_out, duck_ratio, duck_attack, duck_release}, sfx [{id, file, at, gain_db}], master {target, ceiling, voiceRms}. Times are film seconds; files are relative to demo-video/film/. Every other field here is a note for people and is ignored by the mix. Sources and terms: audio/SOURCES.md.

music.note: bed.wav is cut on the film's bar lines (120 BPM, one bar = 2.0 s, film time 0 = file time 0) and already carries its own level ride, start and ending, so the fades here are only guards. duck_release is 900 ms (the default is 420): with 420 the music came back up inside the pauses of a line and three lines stood under 10 dB above it; with 900 every line stands 15 dB or more above it. Alternate: audio/music/bed-alt-1.wav (same loudness: change only the file name). How each bed is cut: audio/music/*.edl.json.

sfx.note: the phone lights up: two soft buzzes. Draft 3 (wp2-6): with the phone's light-up in the sleeper close-up (hook-sleeper-lit-v1, 14.2 s, right after p01), before the cut to the room where its ribbon streams out
shimmer under the ribbon and his taking shape: loudest about 2.3 s in (film 17.3: in the Draft 3 cut the ribbon reaches the desk and he builds up, formed by 18.0), gone by about 19.4
the lid opens: one soft click. Draft 3 cut (reveal-desk-sit plays 4.2 to 8.0 s of reveal-desk-final-v1 at 1.0857x from 23.0): the lid opens at 7.51 s of the clip, film 26.05
rising whoosh; its END is the event, on the cut at 32.0
soft swish with a faint tick on the cut at 54.0
the same, a little brighter, on the cut at 72.0
his one tap on the phone: WP3's manifest gives tap_at_s 4.04 for morning-brief-final-v4 (use_from_s 1.0), so the tap lands 3.04 s into the slot that starts at 100.5
Draft 3 (V20): the reveal's shimmer, quieter, under the return: loudest about 2.3 s in (film 106.6), as the ribbon flows into the phone (105.7 to 107.4); gone by about 108.7
lights come on across the planet: loudest about 1.3 s in (film 113.7), gone by 115.6
one warm chime on D with the end card; silent by 119.8

sfx_note: To move an effect, set at = event_s - sync_s (sync_s is the moment inside the file that belongs on the picture event; audio/sfx/sfx.json lists it per file). All effects are made by audio/sfx/make_sfx.py.
master_note: ceiling is -2.5, not -1.5: the limiter in tools/mix.mjs holds SAMPLE peaks 0.3 dB under the ceiling, and the true peak of this mix then comes out about 1 dB higher (measured: ceiling -2.0 gave a true peak of -1.3 dBFS in the AAC file, -2.5 gave -1.8, -3.0 gave -2.5). -2.5 keeps the film file under -1.5 dBFS true peak.
